propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric is blind to cycles of length >= 2 because it only detects adjacent identical signatures, scoring a real 4-call cycle as 1 while healthy breadth-diverse runs score 5+

A windowed distinct-ratio (trailing 24 calls, cardinality/window, trip at <= 0.50) detects both adjacent repeats and non-adjacent cycles, firing on pathological runs (0.04–0.167) while never triggering on healthy traces (minimum 0.833)

The new distinct_ratio_window field must be added to _repetition_summary output alongside existing counters with module-level constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50, and adopted by consumers c827 and aec1
distinct_ratio_window must report None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short all-identical prefixes
Existing repetition counters and privacy contract (hashed arguments) remain unchanged; the new signal is additive and order-insensitive
